svg.text: Distributed watermark recovery: four interacting dimensions
1,200 input lines · 20 random fragments per cell · exact authenticated session recovery
Columns: placement interval (smaller = more frequent) · Rows: symbol repetition · Cell axes: copied fragment size × carrier corruption
Move right for larger consumed inputs; move upward inside a panel for more corruption; compare columns for watermark frequency and rows for repetition.
Each percentage is 20 deterministic random contiguous fragments. HMAC + CRC must both validate. Synthetic corpus; descriptive, not a production guarantee.
